analysis: Reviewed docs/architecture/inference.md (documentation-only; header bumped to 2026-10-21). Units cover base text lines 831-1204 (MiMo native ownership, media decode accounting, coordinator-serving channels, invariants) and head text lines 1-396 (GLM5Next boundary, measurements, calibration). No executable code, wire protocol, key custody, attestation or authorization controls change. Head-side changes noted: line 61 adds that a refused SSD store's typed reason reaches the bridge for local /metrics only (no coordinator exposure; relevant to T-041, so cache-store refusal reasons remain local); lines 71-310 add GLM5Next documentation (exact catalog build glm-5.3-flash, hardware gate, hash chain from catalog to revision receipt to per-file manifest, shipped-template requirement, fail-closed retained-owner semantics). These are documented claims about source not supplied, so I cannot verify them; none contradicts the threat model (T-041, T-027, T-012, TB-007). The patch excerpt is truncated and later head ranges (902-910, 928, 939-959, 1225-1250, 1498-1505) were not supplied in the head units, so those are coverage limits, not evidence of safety. The next pass should check that any /metrics exposure of the SSD refusal reason stays local and reveals no prompt-derived data, and that the GLM hash-chain and template-pinning claims match the implementation. No finding is raised.
